# styles

**In one sentence:** the `nf-*` design kit: colour/spacing tokens plus one CSS file per reusable component (buttons, pills, panels, cards, console, ...).

## Why it exists
It keeps the look of the app in one self-contained kit. Its own header says it can be copied into another project and re-skinned by overriding the custom properties (CSS variables) in `tokens.css`.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `index.css` | Entry point: imports `tokens.css` first, then every component file. |
| `tokens.css` | The `:root` variables (about 120): night/ink colours, surfaces, borders, spacing, type, radii, shadows, control heights. |
| `window.css` | `.nf-window` app frame and column variables; also a `.nf-titlebar` / `.nf-winbtn` title bar. |
| `appbar.css` | Top bar: logo, title, path, run-status pill (`.nf-runstatus`). |
| `workspace.css` | Three-column grid of the project window (`.nf-workspace`, `.nf-col`). |
| `panel.css` | Card-like panels with head, title, body (`.nf-panel`). |
| `forms.css` | Fields, labels, inputs, selects, checkboxes, input groups. |
| `button.css` | `.nf-btn` with primary / secondary / ghost / small / block variants. |
| `pill.css` | Status pills (`.nf-pill--done`, `--info`, `--warning`, `--danger`, `--muted`, `--optional`, ...). |
| `step.css` | Pipeline step rows (`.nf-step`). |
| `console.css` | The wrapping log console (`.nf-console`) and a `.nf-progress` bar. |
| `statusbar.css` | Bottom status bar (`.nf-statusbar`). |
| `toolbar.css` | `.nf-toolbar` and the `.nf-search` box. |
| `project-card.css` | Library grid and project cards (`.nf-grid`, `.nf-projcard`). |
| `metric.css` | Metric tiles and key/value rows (`.nf-metric`, `.nf-kv`, `.nf-divider`). |

## Who uses it
- `static/styles.css` imports `styles/index.css` before `core/foundation.css` and the feature CSS.
- Class names are used in `static/index.html` and in JS-built markup (`library/view.js`, `project/view.js`, `job/view.js`, `settings/`).
- Tests: `tests/ui/static/css_overflow.test.js` checks the overflow rules in these files.

## Good to know
Some kit classes are not used anywhere in `static/*.html` or `*.js` (checked by name):
- all of `metric.css` (`nf-metric*`, `nf-kv*`, `nf-divider`, `nf-eyebrow-mono`);
- `nf-titlebar*` and `nf-winbtn*` in `window.css`; `nf-toolbar*` in `toolbar.css` (only `nf-search` is used);
- `nf-progress`, `nf-btn--ghost`, `nf-btn--block`, `nf-pill--success`, `nf-projcard__check` / `__foot` / `__stat`;
- `nf-runstatus--busy/--error/--ok` (the shell recolours the pill via `data-job-status` in `shell/shell.css` instead).
They may be kept on purpose as part of the reusable kit; nothing says so either way.
